operations.command: set -e; nix eval --json /etc/nixos#nixosConfigurations.VM-TEST-Standard-Boot.config.settings.disk.persistence.enable | grep -Fx true; nix eval --json /etc/nixos#nixosConfigurations.VM-TEST-Standard-Boot.config.settings.disk.immutability.enable | grep -Fx false; nix eval --json /etc/nixos#nixosConfigurations.VM-TEST-Standard-Boot.config.systemd.services --apply 'services: builtins.hasAttr "persistence-mounts" services' | grep -Fx true; nix eval --json /etc/nixos#nixosConfigurations.VM-TEST-Standard-Boot.config.boot.initrd.systemd.services --apply 'services: builtins.hasAttr "immutability" services' | grep -Fx false; printf config-ok
set -e; chmod 0755 /tmp; rm -rf /tmp/.X11-unix /tmp/.ICE-unix /tmp/e2e-tmp; test "$(stat -c %a /tmp)" = 755; printf tmp-poisoned

set -e; test "$(stat -c %a /tmp)" = 1777; test "$(systemctl show -p Result --value systemd-tmpfiles-setup.service)" = success; su -s /bin/sh nobody -c 'mkdir /tmp/e2e-tmp && rmdir /tmp/e2e-tmp'; printf tmp-ok
set -e; findmnt -rn --target /etc/nixos | grep -F '@persist/dirs/etc!nixos'; test -d /etc/nixos/.git; printf persistence-mounted
